posts.text:
Today is election day in New Jersey, and this campaign will come down to one question: 

Are you better off today than you were in January 2025?

Video

New Jersey! Today is our Primary Election Day!

Make your plan, get out there, and make your voice heard.

Every vote strengthens our democracy. Find your polling location now: voter.svrs.nj.gov/polling-pl…

I love this young man, obviously influenced by who he is dressing up like. 

We all make a difference in more ways than we know. 

People are watching, and they take note of how we live, how we love, and how we give. 

May we strive each day to lead by example, showing up as our best selves, extending grace, and offering mercy. May our lives help, heal, and serve others… and perhaps even inspire others to do the same.

op: @majicallynews

Video

No president gets to weaponize the government against the women who stand up to him. Trump lost in court, so now he’s using taxpayer money, and the people who are supposed to keep us safe, to persecute his victim all over again.

Trump’s slush fund isn’t just corruption, it's taking Congress’ constitutional power to reward those who beat police officers on January 6th. 

Every American should be standing up and speaking out to defend our constitution and end this corruption.

Video

This got me. 

I'm reminded of the quote:

"If you have come here to help me, you are wasting your time. But if you have come because your liberation is bound up with mine, then let us work together.”

May we free ourselves in service of others.

op: @hdmastery

Video

This election won’t be about left and right, it will be about right and wrong.

For 250 years Americans have stood up and spoke up against the powerful, we have to do the same this November and hold President Trump accountable.

Video

The boss is speaking truth to power – calling out the nightmare at Delaney Hall. He’s shining a light on the suffering in this for-profit facility and Trump’s cruelty that’s tearing families apart.

I‘ve met these detainees–our neighbors, small business owners, high school athletes. I met the mother ripped from her newborn American baby, denied proper medical care.

This is a moral stain on our nation.

@usatodayentertainment

Video

Trump wants his face on your money. On your passport. On your national park pass. 

This was never about you. 
It was always about him.

The elections this November are a moral moment in America.

We need a Congress that will hold Trump accountable and deliver for the American people.

Video

Wisdom from an extraordinarily emotionally aware child.

op: @drelishagoldstein

Video

To anyone out there doing the hard, unseen work of lifting others—whether you're a teacher, parent, friend, colleague, or just showing up with love: YOU matter. Your heart, your effort, your light is making a difference

op: @kaleashak123456 on TikTok

Video

Donald Trump promised to “drain the swamp”–twice! Instead of rooting out corruption, he refused to divest from his businesses, turned the presidency into a personal cash cow, and he & his family are now worth billions — while hardworking American families are getting sicker and poorer.

op:n@msnownews

Video

We should all be deeply offended. This is OUR taxpayer money, and elected officials who are supposed to be accountable to us are carrying out deeply cruel immigration policies in Newark and across the country.

Video

What a heartwarming moment when a woman encourages this man to let his inner child out, to run through sprinklers and ultimately beat the heat. 

May we all encourage more, help more, and never lose the part of us that still wants to run through the sprinklers.

Video

The American people know the truth: Trump’s policies are making them sicker and poorer. Families can't keep up with the cost of groceries, healthcare, and gas because of Trump’s chaos, cruelty and corruption. 

Together we must fight to redeem the American dream for working families. 

op: @fightforprogress

Video

Delaney Hall needs to be closed now. This nightmare needs to end now.

Video
Trump’s vanity projects are a monument to his ego, built on the backs of struggling families.

At Delaney Hall I met with a woman who was taken from her newborn baby, an American, who was not getting the proper medical care she needed.

This for-profit facility and Trump’s cruelty is a moral stain on our community and nation.

Video
